title: Sunday Morning — EN/ES/FR (Chas and Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm duet male female vocal 96bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling intimate Spanish French language learning family Sunday Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English — Chas]
Sunday morning and the kettle's on before the birds decide
She's already been in the garden — I can tell by what's outside
The clippers on the table and the gloves left on the step
Sunday morning and the garden's had its bath already — yep

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El domingo por la mañana la tetera está encendida
[Sunday morning and the kettle is on]
Ella ya ha estado en el jardín — lo nota mi vida
[She has already been in the garden — my life notices it]
Las tijeras en la mesa y los guantes en el escalón
[The clippers on the table and the gloves on the step]
El domingo por la mañana tiene su propia canción
[Sunday morning has its own song]

[Chorus — English — Both]
Sunday morning, Sunday morning
Before the family phones, before the week's returning
Sunday morning, Sunday morning
The garden and the kettle and the light
Sunday morning — both of us — getting it right
The gardens still growing

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le dimanche matin la bouilloire est allumée avant les oiseaux
[Sunday morning and the kettle is on before the birds]
Elle est déjà dans le jardin — je le sais par les ciseaux
[She is already in the garden — I know it by the clippers]
Le dimanche matin a sa propre logique et son tempo
[Sunday morning has its own logic and its tempo]
Et nous la connaissons tous les deux — c'est notre eau
[And we both know it — it is our water]

[Outro — All three languages]
Sunday morning… El domingo por la mañana… Le dimanche matin
The gardens still growing — El jardín sigue creciendo — Le jardin continue de pousser
The gardens still growing
